description: List published comparisons whose products remain cached, ordered by slug, with updated_at freshness. Omitting limit returns the full published index. Otherwise use offset, page_size and has_more; ignored lists unusable paging parameters. Results may change between requests. Cache-only.

limit.description: How many pairs to return, clamped to 50. OMIT IT and you get the whole index — this is the sitemap's own source, so it is never truncated by default.

offset.description: How many pairs to skip. Unusable values are ignored and named in `ignored`; a negative value is clamped to 0.

name: lianex_vs

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 freshness of the fresher side, or `null`.
updated_at.title: Updated At

VsIndexResponse.description: Published comparisons ordered by slug. Omit limit to return the full index; page_size is then null. Results may change between requests.

has_more.description: Read this instead of a total; no total is reported.
has_more.title: Has More
